verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page claims it can "Detect tables, checkboxes, images, and handwriting" through Agentic OCR. Extraction returns per-field confidence scores and citations, and the docs say to auto-trust high-confidence values and route the rest to human review, which covers the uncertainty-flagging part of the story. A Signature schema type is also documented. The handwriting claim is only a one-line marketing mention, though, with no in-depth docs. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of handwriting recognition accuracy or behavior, explicit support for handwritten annotations or margin notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of handwriting extraction quality.
